grantPackages.title: Merchant-specific HTTP and MCP installation on the participating operator's real deployment, including selected schemas, DNS/TLS, source authority and connection to the maintained native distribution.
Real operator role/authority transfer and merchant-specific onboarding repairs discovered during the installation; use shipped admission, withdrawal and recovery components.

Deploy existing native buyer, privileged finalizer and merchant receiver across independently operated provider APIs; implement actual cursor/version/auth differences and missing deployment-specific integration.

Implement the deployment-specific threat model and operational response: signer/observer custody, actionable alert delivery, acknowledgement and recovery for real pending-transfer or merchant-notice failures.
Production mainnet integration on actual merchant infrastructure, original asset/account authority, protected signer/observer configuration, native provider support and controlled release/cutover.
Integrate existing encrypted recovery and outbox continuity into actual supervision/off-host retention and key rotation; resolve material deployment findings and deliver maintainer handover.
